title: The Vanishing Blue Diamond
overview: A blue diamond disappears from a locked display during a crowded charity preview. The alarm never sounded, and several people had legitimate access.
objective: Reconstruct how the diamond was removed and distinguish a planned inside theft from an opportunity theft.

hypotheses.statement: Exhibitions manager Rowan Pike used a copied display key during a scheduled lighting test to steal the diamond.
A guest lifted the diamond during the reception and escaped through the public entrance.

evidence.title: Loss report
evidence.content: The blue diamond was discovered missing at 8:10 PM. The locked display showed no visible damage.

evidence.title: Event access list
evidence.content: Guests entered through one monitored entrance. Rowan Pike, security lead Nia Grant, and technician Leon Wu held staff access.

evidence.title: Display alarm maintenance log
evidence.content: The case alarm was placed in service mode at 6:42 PM for a lighting test requested by Rowan Pike. Service mode disables the open sensor.

evidence.title: Key cabinet audit
evidence.content: A key blank was removed from the cabinet two days earlier using Rowan's code. No duplicate key was returned.

evidence.title: Entrance camera summary
evidence.content: The guest entrance remained continuously staffed. No guest left carrying an item or bypassed the bag check.

suspects.name: Rowan Pike
suspects.role: Exhibitions manager who requested the lighting test

witness_statements.statement: The entrance was monitored throughout the reception and no guest bypassed the exit checks.

timeline.event: A key blank was removed using Rowan Pike's access code.
The display alarm was placed in service mode for a lighting test.
